links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid) of chatbot interstitial cystitis patient information
links.effect: Responses averaged 256 words with college-level readability (median Flesch-Kincaid 25.4 [IQR 20.89-28.50]) across all platforms, limiting accessibility.
links.quote: Responses averaged 256 words and college-level readability (median [IQR] Flesch-Kincaid score 25.4 [20.89-28.50]) across all platforms, limiting accessibility.

links.outcome: Reading level of chatbot patient information versus typical patient comprehension
links.effect: Content generated at college-level readability (median Flesch-Kincaid 25.4), above typical patient comprehension.
links.quote: Artificial intelligence chatbots offer generally accurate and understandable information about interstitial cystitis but lack actionable guidance and generate content at reading levels above typical patient comprehension.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the quality, readability, understandability, and misinformation of health responses from four commercial LLM chatbots to patient queries on interstitial cystitis without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards.
